_schema.description: Paired measurements of qvac-fabric-speech.cpp against other engines, shown on the weekly page under each task. Rows are taken from a campaign that measured both engines on the same machine with the same inputs; they are dated and are not on the weekly clock. ratio is competitor time divided by qvac time (above 1x means qvac is faster), given as 'short / long' input where the campaign used two input lengths.

fields.task: ASR, TTS, TTS cloning or Music (the page's section).
fields.model: Model as the weekly page names it.
fields.engine: Competitor engine as the campaign labels it.
fields.engine_version: Competitor build and model from the campaign.
fields.qvac_version: fabric-speech and ggml commits of the campaign's qvac build.
fields.host: Tailscale host when the campaign ran on a weekly machine, otherwise the device label.
fields.backend: cpu, cuda, vulkan, metal or coreml.
fields.qvac_rtf: qvac real-time factor as the campaign reports it (short / long input).
fields.ratio: competitor time divided by qvac time (short / long input).

rows.source: QVAC speech engines report (Gustavo Araujo, 2026-10-01 edition)
rows.harness: Ratios are competitor time divided by QVAC time. Short is an 11.0 s clip; long is a 98.49 s clip. Apple M2 rows are the Core ML versus Metal run on 8 FLEURS clips (70 s), median total transcription time excluding model load: Core ML 64.25 ms versus Metal 135.33 ms (2.11× end-to-end, 3.67× on the encoder), WER 3.85 % versus 5.13 %.

rows.source: QVAC speech engines report (Gustavo Araujo, 2026-10-01 edition)
rows.harness: Ratios are competitor end-to-end process wall divided by QVAC wall, model load included; short is a 9-word prompt (~3.1 s of speech), long a 76-word prompt (~26 s). Core ML rows use the Metal build with the vocoder sidecar and compare against audio.cpp on Metal. Measured 2026-09-24 to 2026-09-30 at fabric-speech f265d81b on ggml speech@59a0ca2c (2026-09-15, before the ggml 0.20.2 merge). Strix Halo rows come from qvac-dev-strix-0 (32 CPU threads); Mac Studio rows from qvac-dev-mac-arm64 (16 threads); RTX 5090 rows from qvac-dev-linux-x64 (10 threads; the added quantization tiers ran on its second GPU with their competitors re-run on the same GPU). DGX Spark GB10 rows come from spark-d9ca and cover the GPU backends only (CUDA, Vulkan). RTX 3080 rows were not re-measured.

rows.source: QVAC speech engines report (Gustavo Araujo, 2026-10-01 edition)
rows.harness: Ratios are competitor end-to-end process wall divided by QVAC wall (short ~3 s and long ~24 s of speech). The LM q4_0 tier pairs the q4_0 LM with the q8_0 codec decoder. Core ML rows use the codec sidecar and compare against audio.cpp on Metal. The Jetson Orin row (Orin Nano 8 GB Super, 25 W mode, Vulkan) compares against audio.cpp on the short text only; its medium and long runs failed on Vulkan.
